final_message:
Done. All 3 tests pass, plus I verified the README examples and error cases directly.

Implementation in `cronfields/fields.py`:
- `expand_field` (cronfields/fields.py:9) — splits on commas (rejecting empty items), then per item handles `*`, `N`, `A-B`, `*/S`, `A-B/S` via `_expand_item`. Numbers are ASCII digits or case-insensitive name lookups, range-checked against `lo..hi`; ranges must not wrap; steps must be ≥ 1; results are deduplicated and sorted.
- `parse_cron` (cronfields/fields.py:22) — `line.split()` must yield exactly 5 fields, expanded against the per-field ranges/names in `FIELDS`, with the weekday field's `7` remapped to `0` and re-sorted.
